tasks.title: Email about safe social-media project
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English teacher, Mrs. Hill, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Safe social-media project – your ideas
paragraphs: As you know, our class is helping to plan a project about using social media safely. We need to decide on the main issue to focus on. Should we teach students how to protect their private information online, or how to avoid fake news and false information? Which do you think is more important and why?
Also, we need to choose one practical activity for the project. Would you prefer to create a poster about online safety, or organise a talk from a social-media expert?
Finally, can you suggest one way to make sure students remember what they learn after the project ends?

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for your reply
listItems: Say which issue you think is more important (private information OR fake news) and explain why.
Choose an activity (poster OR expert talk) and give a reason.
Suggest one way to help students remember what they learn.
Ask Mrs. Hill when the project will start.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Mrs. Hill using all the notes.

tasks.title: Article about safe social media
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: Our school magazine wants to hear your ideas about the safe social-media project.
Do you think this project will help students use social media more safely?
What is the most important thing students should learn about staying safe online?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it in the next magazine!

tasks.title: Story about a social-media surprise
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.
Your story must begin with this sentence:
"When the programme coordinator checked the project comments, she saw a message that made her stop."
